instruction: Independently capture/approve complete metadata of every connectable database including template1; all roles/databases/tablespaces; per-database user objects, languages, transforms, text search, statistics, event triggers, foreign objects, publications/subscriptions. Use actual Source normalized catalog projection: real JOIN maps replace physical OIDs with stable qualified relation/type/function signature/operator/opclass/collation/role/tablespace identities; native PG deparse replaces pg_node_tree physical OIDs/locations. All known semantic/state columns remain bound; unknown columns/references fail. Prepare registration marker projection from exact Source DDL and accepted baseline identities, never guess future OIDs, precreate/rollback a marker, replace subject A after registration, or skip deep equality. Every local user ordinary/partitioned table requires exact row count and classification empty / accepted-platform-static / registration-marker; static platform tables are individually declared exceptions, never business/auth data. No table contents/passwords/secret views are read. Auth users must be zero before bootstrap and all Clued objects absent. Nonconnectable database omissions require explicit independent baseline exceptions. Before-bootstrap additionally binds the exact registration marker DDL/owner/count1. No wildcard, inaccessible connectable database omission, or caller-declared empty boolean.
